driver_archetypes.rationale: Saval et al. 2023: compliant car baseline; high tau and low accel/decel ensure cars stop at red (M2/early/car ~0) and do not run red (M3/share/car ~0).
Car violators (custom2) drawn from 'car' distribution; params identical to car_saval so they behave physically like compliant cars but are eligible for queue_space_seeking rules.
Saval et al. 2023 motorcycle baseline; minGap=1.9 and minGapLat=0.3 allow close following but require explicit rules to trigger overshoot (M4/overshoot_depth) and wrong-lane usage.
Custom1 motorcycle violators drawing from 'moto' distribution; identical physical params to moto_saval but eligible for queue_space_seeking and illegal_left_box rules.

Illegal left-turning motorcycles (distribution moto_violator); jmTimegapMinor=1.0s is the default lever for box-waiting duration; physical behaviour same as compliant motos but with different distribution.

traci_rules.rationale: Saval et al. 2023: motorcycles at the stop line have a 50% chance to run red (p0=0.5); k=0 removes swarm effect; targets M3/share/moto (obs 0.09048, sim 0.02 -> needs higher effective p via early_start).

Targets M2/early/moto (obs 0.1303); p=0.13 approximates the probability of creeping over the stop line in the last 5s of red. Note: This adds to swarm_red_running counts, potentially inflating M3/share/moto; the share will be calibrated by the distribution of 'front-row' states.

Targets M8/moto wrong-lane share (obs 0.2131) and M9a (queue blocking). q=50m triggers seeking at moderate queues. t_g_s=7s estimates green clearance. p_wrong_lane=0.21 sets the target wrong-lane probability directly.
Field observation: most motorcycles pass a standing U-turner; p=0.8 captures high bypass probability, t_wait=2s is the short hold before deciding.
Field observation: cars rarely bypass standing U-turners; p=0.1 reflects low probability compared to motorcycles.
